capabilities: Cast three-coin hexagram readings with changing lines in a sidebar panel
Save readings as Markdown notes with frontmatter or insert them at the cursor
Stream reading interpretations from a local OpenAI-compatible LLM server
Generate a meditation image per reading via the Local Image Generator plugin
Configure language, register, filenames, and per-field frontmatter keys
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Optional AI and image features stay off until configured; setup and troubleshooting guides live in separate documentation files.
intentEvidence: Native Obsidian re-implementation of the oracle core from the Yijing web/app project.
motivation: The author built a focused native plugin rather than a port, so that "the vault is the oracle journal".
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to cast I Ching readings or keep them as searchable, linkable vault notes.
